newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Generale Bank ups ING EPS, price target.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank ups ING EPS, price target.

text.p: COMMENT: 1997 Q1 figures showed solid underlying growth. We estimate current fair value at Dfl 140. As we expect a market decline due to an expected rise in interest rates, we reiterate our Buy recommendation on a 12 month price target of Dfl 120.
Estimates (NLG): EPS pvs EPS P/E Dividend
Note: Analyst Harry Luchtenveld said on Friday he now had a 12 month price target for ING shares of 140 guilders as Generale was upgrading its forecast for the AEX share index.
His previous ING price target of 95 guilders had been set in March.
He declined to specify the new share index target but said the previous target in the "low 800s" was set two months ago.
The AEX broke through the 900 point level for the first time on Thursday.
